rule: A package counts toward the usable-profession goal only through a validated scoped maturity record at TEST or higher. Package/body construction status may remain EXPERIMENTAL while the tested scope is bounded explicitly; a mapped target, generated file, structurally valid package, or convincing demo never counts by itself.
full_body_status_rule: Full-body package/body status remains a separate stronger reconstruction claim and is not automatically promoted by scoped TEST evidence.
